name: Heidegger, Shinra Executive
oracle_text:
At the beginning of combat on your turn, target creature you control gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is the number of Soldiers you control.
At the beginning of your end step, create a number of 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens equal to the number of opponents who control more creatures than you.
blocked_sentences: At the beginning of your end step, create a number of 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens equal to the number of opponents who control more creatures than you.

needs.what: a value that counts the players in a player spec who satisfy a per-player comparison, e.g. {"player_count_where": {"players": "each_opponent", "cmp": ">", "left": {"count": {"types": ["Creature"], "controller": {"binding": "counted_player"}}}, "right": {"creatures_you_control": true}}} -- "the number of opponents who control more creatures than you", evaluated once at resolution so it can be the amount of a single create_token
needs.why_existing_wont_do: player_count counts every player a spec names with no filter, and select_players has no conditional form; max_count_of/min_count_of answer 'an opponent'/'each opponent' (existential/universal) but not 'how many'. for_each_player over each_opponent with an if + create_token of 1 is the near miss and is a different card: it creates the tokens in separate events (several batched 'one or more tokens' triggers instead of one) and, unless the comparison is snapshotted, each token made raises creatures_you_control before the next opponent is compared
